alt: 海邊、城鎮廣場與山村的人們都掛起彩帶，不同年齡的居民一起揮手、拍掌和跳舞慶祝。
scene_prompt: A warm panoramic illustration of people from several far-separated regions all celebrating the same joyful occasion together. Across one wide scene, show a seaside community at left, a central town square, and a mountain village at right, linked visually by flowing simple green and blue festive ribbons. Diverse families, older people and children wave, clap and dance together in every place. Small original paper lanterns and confetti; no national flags, no political symbols, no text. Clearly more than one household or locality.
